from manim import *
import numpy as np

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Introduction
        intro_text = Text("Activation Functions", font_size=60).to_edge(UP)
        self.play(Write(intro_text))

        # Sigmoid Function
        sigmoid_text = Text("Sigmoid Function", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
        sigmoid_graph = Axes(x_range=[-10, 10, 2], y_range=[-0.1, 1.1, 0.1], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        sigmoid_function = sigmoid_graph.plot(lambda x: 1 / (1 + np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-10, 10], color=BLUE)
        self.play(Transform(intro_text, sigmoid_text), Create(sigmoid_graph), Create(sigmoid_function))

        # Tanh Function
        tanh_text = Text("Tanh Function", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
        tanh_graph = Axes(x_range=[-10, 10, 2], y_range=[-1.1, 1.1, 0.1], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        tanh_function = tanh_graph.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x), x_range=[-10, 10], color=RED)
        self.play(Transform(sigmoid_text, tanh_text), Transform(sigmoid_graph, tanh_graph), Transform(sigmoid_function, tanh_function))

        # ReLU Function
        relu_text = Text("ReLU Function", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
        relu_graph = Axes(x_range=[-10, 10, 2], y_range=[-1, 10, 1], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        relu_function = relu_graph.plot(lambda x: np.maximum(0, x), x_range=[-10, 10], color=GREEN)
        self.play(Transform(tanh_text, relu_text), Transform(tanh_graph, relu_graph), Transform(tanh_function, relu_function))

        # Leaky ReLU Function
        leaky_relu_text = Text("Leaky ReLU Function", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
        leaky_relu_graph = Axes(x_range=[-10, 10, 2], y_range=[-1, 10, 1], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        leaky_relu_function = leaky_relu_graph.plot(lambda x: np.maximum(0.1 * x, x), x_range=[-10, 10], color=YELLOW)
        self.play(Transform(relu_text, leaky_relu_text), Transform(relu_graph, leaky_relu_graph), Transform(relu_function, leaky_relu_function))

        # Conclusion
        conclusion_text = Text("Activation Functions", font_size=60).to_edge(UP)
        self.play(Transform(leaky_relu_text, conclusion_text))

from manim import *
import numpy as np

config.frame_rate = 60
config.pixel_width = 1920
config.pixel_height = 1080

class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Cinematic color palette
        BG_COLOR = "#0f172a"
        GOLD = "#fbbf24"
        CYAN = "#22d3ee"
        ROSE = "#fb7185"
        VIOLET = "#a78bfa"
        EMERALD = "#34d399"
        AMBER = "#f59e0b"
        
        self.camera.background_color = BG_COLOR
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 1: Cinematic Title Sequence (4s)
        # ==========================================
        title = Text("Fourier Synthesis", font="Times New Roman", font_size=72, weight=BOLD, color=GOLD)
        subtitle = Text("Reconstructing Discontinuity from Harmonics", font="Times New Roman", font_size=36, color=CYAN)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        
        formula_intro = MathTex(r"f(x) = \frac{4}{\pi}\sum_{n=1,3,5...}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n}\sin(nx)", font_size=48, color=WHITE)
        formula_intro.next_to(subtitle, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        title_group = VGroup(title, subtitle, formula_intro)
        title_group.move_to(ORIGIN)
        
        # Opening camera: tight on title
        self.camera.frame.set(width=title_group.width * 1.5)
        self.camera.frame.move_to(title_group)
        
        self.play(
            Write(title, run_time=1.5, rate_func=smooth),
            FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.5, run_time=1.5, rate_func=smooth),
            lag_ratio=0.3
        )
        self.play(Write(formula_intro, run_time=2, rate_func=smooth))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 2: Setup Coordinate Systems (3s)

            y_length=6,
            axis_config={"color": "#475569", "stroke_width": 2, "include_ticks": True},
            tips=True
        ).shift(LEFT*2.5)
        
        # Frequency-domain axes (right)
        freq_axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 14, 2],
            y_range=[0, 1.5, 0.5],
            x_length=4,
            y_length=6,
            axis_config={"color": "#475569", "stroke_width": 2},
            tips=True
        ).shift(RIGHT*5.5)
        
        # Labels
        time_label = Text("Time Domain", font="Arial", font_size=24, color="#94a3b8").next_to(time_axes, UP, buff=0.3)
        freq_label = Text("Frequency Spectrum", font="Arial", font_size=24, color="#94a3b8").next_to(freq_axes, UP, buff=0.3)
        x_label = MathTex("x", font_size=28, color="#cbd5e1").next_to(time_axes.x_axis.get_end(), DOWN+RIGHT)
        y_label = MathTex("f(x)", font_size=28, color="#cbd5e1").next_to(time_axes.y_axis.get_end(), LEFT)
        n_label = MathTex("n", font_size=28, color="#cbd5e1").next_to(freq_axes.x_axis.get_end(), DOWN)
        amp_label = MathTex("A_n", font_size=28, color="#cbd5e1").next_to(freq_axes.y_axis.get_end(), LEFT)
        
        # Target square wave (faint)
        def square_wave(x):
            return (4/np.pi) * sum((1/n) * np.sin(n*x) for n in range(1, 40, 2))
        
        target_curve = time_axes.plot(square_wave, x_range=[-4, 4, 0.01], color=GOLD, stroke_width=4, stroke_opacity=0.25)
        target_label = Text("Target: Square Wave", font_size=20, color=GOLD, opacity=0.6).next_to(target_curve, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        # Camera transition to workspace
        full_group = VGroup(time_axes, freq_axes, time_label, freq_label, x_label, y_label, n_label, amp_label)
        
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set(width=16),
            FadeOut(title_group, shift=UP*2),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                Create(time_axes, run_time=1.5),
                Create(freq_axes, run_time=1.5),
                Write(time_label),
                Write(freq_label),
                Write(x_label),
                Write(y_label),
                Write(n_label),
                Write(amp_label),
                lag_ratio=0.15
            )
        )
        
        self.play(
            Create(target_curve),
            FadeIn(target_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 3: Iterative Harmonic Construction (25s)
        # ==========================================
        colors = [CYAN, ROSE, VIOLET, EMERALD, AMBER, "#f472b6", "#60a5fa", "#a3e635"]
        partial_sum_curve = None
        current_sum_func = lambda x: 0
        spectrum_bars = VGroup()
        equation_terms = VGroup()
        
        for idx, n in enumerate(range(1, 15, 2)):
            color = colors[idx % len(colors)]
            
            # Mathematical term
            coeff = 4/(n*np.pi)
            term_func = lambda x, n=n, c=coeff: c * np.sin(n*x)
            new_sum_func = lambda x, cs=current_sum_func, tf=term_func: cs(x) + tf(x)
            
            # Time domain: Individual harmonic
            harmonic_curve = time_axes.plot(term_func, x_range=[-4, 4, 0.01], color=color, stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.7)
            
            # Time domain: Cumulative sum
            new_sum_curve = time_axes.plot(new_sum_func, x_range=[-4, 4, 0.01], color=GOLD, stroke_width=3)
            
            # Frequency domain: Bar
            bar = Rectangle(
                height=freq_axes.c2p(0, coeff)[1] - freq_axes.c2p(0, 0)[1],
                width=0.4,
                fill_color=color,
                fill_opacity=0.8,
                stroke_color=WHITE,
                stroke_width=1
            )
            bar.move_to(freq_axes.c2p(n, coeff/2))
            
            # Equation term
            if idx == 0:
                term_tex = MathTex(r"\frac{4}{\pi}\sin(x)", font_size=32, color=color)
            else:
                term_tex = MathTex(r"+ \frac{4}{" + str(n) + r"\pi}\sin(" + str(n) + r"x)", font_size=32, color=color)
            
            if idx % 2 == 0:
                term_tex.to_corner(UR, buff=0.4)
                if idx > 0:
                    term_tex.next_to(equation_terms[idx-2], DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3)
            else:
                term_tex.next_to(equation_terms[idx-1], RIGHT, buff=0.3)
                if term_tex.get_right()[0] > 7:
                    term_tex.next_to(equation_terms[idx-1], DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3)
            
            equation_terms.add(term_tex)
            
            # Animation choreography
            self.play(
                Create(harmonic_curve, run_time=1.2),
                GrowFromCenter(bar, run_time=1),
                Write(term_tex, run_time=1),
                rate_func=smooth
            )
            
            # Transform sum
            if partial_sum_curve is None:
                self.play(
                    TransformFromCopy(harmonic_curve, new_sum_curve),
                    run_time=1.5,
                    rate_func=smooth
                )
            else:
                self.play(
                    Transform(partial_sum_curve, new_sum_curve),
                    run_time=1.2,
                    rate_func=smooth
                )
            
            spectrum_bars.add(bar)
            partial_sum_curve = new_sum_curve
            current_sum_func = new_sum_func
            
            # Fade harmonic but keep sum visible
            self.play(FadeOut(harmonic_curve, run_time=0.4))
            
            # Periodic camera movements for emphasis
            if idx == 3:
                # Zoom to show approximation quality
                self.play(
                    self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(time_axes.get_center()).set(width=12),
                    run_time=2,
                    rate_func=smooth
                )
                self.wait(0.5)
                self.play(
                    self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set(width=16),
                    run_time=2,
                    rate_func=smooth
                )
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 4: Gibbs Phenomenon Deep Dive (6s)
        # ==========================================
        gibbs_title = Text("Gibbs Phenomenon: Non-uniform Convergence", font_size=28, color=ROSE)
        gibbs_title.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1.2)
        
        # Highlight discontinuity region
        discontinuity_point = time_axes.c2p(0, 0)
        zoom_region = Square(side_length=2, color=ROSE, stroke_width=2).move_to(discontinuity_point)
        
        self.play(
            Create(zoom_region, run_time=1),
            Write(gibbs_title, run_time=1)
        )
        
        # Zoom into Gibbs overshoot
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(discontinuity_point).set(width=3),
            run_time=2.5,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # Annotate overshoot
        overshoot_y = 4/np.pi * sum(1/n * np.sin(n*0.01) for n in range(1, 15, 2))  # Approximate peak
        overshoot_point = time_axes.c2p(0.05, 1.18)  # Gibbs constant ~1.1789797...
        
        dot = Dot(overshoot_point, color=ROSE, radius=0.08)
        label = MathTex(r"\approx 1.18", font_size=24, color=ROSE).next_to(dot, UR, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(dot, scale=2),
            Write(label),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # Return to wide view
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set(width=16),
            FadeOut(zoom_region),
            FadeOut(dot),
            FadeOut(label),
            FadeOut(gibbs_title),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 5: Final Composition (4s)
        # ==========================================
        final_text = Text("Harmonic Superposition: n = 1 to 13", font_size=32, color=WHITE)
        final_text.to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        
        # Emphasize final curve
        glow_curve = time_axes.plot(current_sum_func, x_range=[-4, 4, 0.01], color=GOLD, stroke_width=8, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(glow_curve, run_time=1),
            FadeIn(final_text, run_time=1),
            Circumscribe(partial_sum_curve, run_time=1.5)
        )
        
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Elegant fade out
        self.play(
            FadeOut(time_axes),
            FadeOut(freq_axes),
            FadeOut(spectrum_bars),
            FadeOut(equation_terms),
            FadeOut(partial_sum_curve),
            FadeOut(glow_curve),
            FadeOut(target_curve),
            FadeOut(target_label),
            FadeOut(time_label),
            FadeOut(freq_label),
            FadeOut(x_label),
            FadeOut(y_label),
            FadeOut(n_label),
            FadeOut(amp_label),
            FadeOut(final_text),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *

class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.frame_width = 25
        self.camera.frame_height = 15

        title = Title("Activation Functions in Neural Networks")
        self.play(Write(title))

        sigmoid_text = Tex(r"\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1+e^{-x}}")
        sigmoid_graph = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: (t, 1 / (1 + np.exp(-t))),
            t_min=-10,
            t_max=10,
            color=BLUE,
        )
        sigmoid_graph_label = Tex(r"\text{Sigmoid}").scale(0.7).next_to(sigmoid_graph, DOWN)

        self.play(FadeOut(title))
        self.play(Write(sigmoid_text))
        self.play(ShowCreation(sigmoid_graph))
        self.play(Write(sigmoid_graph_label))
        self.wait(2)

        relu_text = Tex(r"f(x) = \max(0, x)")
        relu_graph = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: (t, np.maximum(0, t)),
            t_min=-10,
            t_max=10,
            color=YELLOW,
        )
        relu_graph_label = Tex(r"\text{ReLU}").scale(0.7).next_to(relu_graph, DOWN)

        self.play(FadeOut(sigmoid_text, sigmoid_graph, sigmoid_graph_label))
        self.play(Write(relu_text))
        self.play(ShowCreation(relu_graph))
        self.play(Write(relu_graph_label))
        self.wait(2)

        tanh_text = Tex(r"\tanh(x) = \frac{\sinh(x)}{\cosh(x)}")
        tanh_graph = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: (t, np.tanh(t)),
            t_min=-10,
            t_max=10,
            color=GREEN,
        )
        tanh_graph_label = Tex(r"\text{Tanh}").scale(0.7).next_to(tanh_graph, DOWN)

        self.play(FadeOut(relu_text, relu_graph, relu_graph_label))
        self.play(Write(tanh_text))
        self.play(ShowCreation(tanh_graph))
        self.play(Write(tanh_graph_label))
        self.wait(2)

        softplus_text = Tex(r"f(x) = \ln(1+e^x)")
        softplus_graph = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: (t, np.log(1 + np.exp(t))),
            t_min=-10,
            t_max=10,
            color=RED,
        )
        softplus_graph_label = Tex(r"\text{Softplus}").scale(0.7).next_to(softplus_graph, DOWN)

        self.play(FadeOut(tanh_text, tanh_graph, tanh_graph_label))
        self.play(Write(softplus_text))
        self.play(ShowCreation(softplus_graph))
        self.play(Write(softplus_graph_label))
        self.wait(2)

        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.5).move_to(ORIGIN),
            run_time=2,
        )
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

config.frame_rate = 60
config.pixel_width = 1920
config.pixel_height = 1080

class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Cinematic color palette
        BG_COLOR = "#0f172a"
        GOLD = "#fbbf24"
        CYAN = "#22d3ee"
        ROSE = "#fb7185"
        VIOLET = "#a78bfa"
        EMERALD = "#34d399"
        AMBER = "#f59e0b"
        
        self.camera.background_color = BG_COLOR
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 1: Cinematic Title Sequence (4s)
        # ==========================================
        title = Text("Fourier Synthesis", font="Times New Roman", font_size=72, weight=BOLD, color=GOLD)
        subtitle = Text("Reconstructing Discontinuity from Harmonics", font="Times New Roman", font_size=36, color=CYAN)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        
        formula_intro = MathTex(r"f(x) = \frac{4}{\pi}\sum_{n=1,3,5...}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n}\sin(nx)", font_size=48, color=WHITE)
        formula_intro.next_to(subtitle, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        title_group = VGroup(title, subtitle, formula_intro)
        title_group.move_to(ORIGIN)
        
        # Opening camera: tight on title
        self.camera.frame.set(width=title_group.width * 1.5)
        self.camera.frame.move_to(title_group)
        
        self.play(
            Write(title, run_time=1.5, rate_func=smooth),
            FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.5, run_time=1.5, rate_func=smooth),
            lag_ratio=0.3
        )
        self.play(Write(formula_intro, run_time=2, rate_func=smooth))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 2: Setup Coordinate Systems (3s)
        # ==========================================
        # Main time-domain axes (left)
        time_axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-4, 4, 1],
            y_range=[-1.8, 1.8, 0.5],
            x_length=10,
            y_length=6,
            axis_config={"color": "#475569", "stroke_width": 2, "include_ticks": True},
            tips=True
        ).shift(LEFT*2.5)
        
        # Frequency-domain axes (right)
        freq_axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 14, 2],
            y_range=[0, 1.5, 0.5],
            x_length=4,
            y_length=6,
            axis_config={"color": "#475569", "stroke_width": 2},
            tips=True
        ).shift(RIGHT*5.5)
        
        # Labels
        time_label = Text("Time Domain", font="Arial", font_size=24, color="#94a3b8").next_to(time_axes, UP, buff=0.3)
        freq_label = Text("Frequency Spectrum", font="Arial", font_size=24, color="#94a3b8").next_to(freq_axes, UP, buff=0.3)
        x_label = MathTex("x", font_size=28, color="#cbd5e1").next_to(time_axes.x_axis.get_end(), DOWN+RIGHT)
        y_label = MathTex("f(x)", font_size=28, color="#cbd5e1").next_to(time_axes.y_axis.get_end(), LEFT)
        n_label = MathTex("n", font_size=28, color="#cbd5e1").next_to(freq_axes.x_axis.get_end(), DOWN)
        amp_label = MathTex("A_n", font_size=28, color="#cbd5e1").next_to(freq_axes.y_axis.get_end(), LEFT)
        
        # Target square wave (faint)
        def square_wave(x):
            return (4/np.pi) * sum((1/n) * np.sin(n*x) for n in range(1, 40, 2))
        
        target_curve = time_axes.plot(square_wave, x_range=[-4, 4, 0.01], color=GOLD, stroke_width=4, stroke_opacity=0.25)
        target_label = Text("Target: Square Wave", font_size=20, color=GOLD, opacity=0.6).next_to(target_curve, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        # Camera transition to workspace
        full_group = VGroup(time_axes, freq_axes, time_label, freq_label, x_label, y_label, n_label, amp_label)
        
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set(width=16),
            FadeOut(title_group, shift=UP*2),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                Create(time_axes, run_time=1.5),
                Create(freq_axes, run_time=1.5),
                Write(time_label),
                Write(freq_label),
                Write(x_label),
                Write(y_label),
                Write(n_label),
                Write(amp_label),
                lag_ratio=0.15
            )
        )
        
        self.play(
            Create(target_curve),
            FadeIn(target_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 3: Iterative Harmonic Construction (25s)
        # ==========================================
        colors = [CYAN, ROSE, VIOLET, EMERALD, AMBER, "#f472b6", "#60a5fa", "#a3e635"]
        partial_sum_curve = None
        current_sum_func = lambda x: 0
        spectrum_bars = VGroup()
        equation_terms = VGroup()
        
        for idx, n in enumerate(range(1, 15, 2)):
            color = colors[idx % len(colors)]
            
            # Mathematical term
            coeff = 4/(n*np.pi)
            term_func = lambda x, n=n, c=coeff: c * np.sin(n*x)
            new_sum_func = lambda x, cs=current_sum_func, tf=term_func: cs(x) + tf(x)
            
            # Time domain: Individual harmonic
            harmonic_curve = time_axes.plot(term_func, x_range=[-4, 4, 0.01], color=color, stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.7)
            
            # Time domain: Cumulative sum
            new_sum_curve = time_axes.plot(new_sum_func, x_range=[-4, 4, 0.01], color=GOLD, stroke_width=3)
            
            # Frequency domain: Bar
            bar = Rectangle(
                height=freq_axes.c2p(0, coeff)[1] - freq_axes.c2p(0, 0)[1],
                width=0.4,
                fill_color=color,
                fill_opacity=0.8,
                stroke_color=WHITE,
                stroke_width=1
            )
            bar.move_to(freq_axes.c2p(n, coeff/2))
            
            # Equation term
            if idx == 0:
                term_tex = MathTex(r"\frac{4}{\pi}\sin(x)", font_size=32, color=color)
            else:
                term_tex = MathTex(r"+ \frac{4}{" + str(n) + r"\pi}\sin(" + str(n) + r"x)", font_size=32, color=color)
            
            if idx % 2 == 0:
                term_tex.to_corner(UR, buff=0.4)
                if idx > 0:
                    term_tex.next_to(equation_terms[idx-2], DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3)
            else:
                term_tex.next_to(equation_terms[idx-1], RIGHT, buff=0.3)
                if term_tex.get_right()[0] > 7:
                    term_tex.next_to(equation_terms[idx-1], DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3)
            
            equation_terms.add(term_tex)
            
            # Animation choreography
            self.play(
                Create(harmonic_curve, run_time=1.2),
                GrowFromCenter(bar, run_time=1),
                Write(term_tex, run_time=1),
                rate_func=smooth
            )
            
            # Transform sum
            if partial_sum_curve is None:
                self.play(
                    TransformFromCopy(harmonic_curve, new_sum_curve),
                    run_time=1.5,
                    rate_func=smooth
                )
            else:
                self.play(
                    Transform(partial_sum_curve, new_sum_curve),
                    run_time=1.2,
                    rate_func=smooth
                )
            
            spectrum_bars.add(bar)
            partial_sum_curve = new_sum_curve
            current_sum_func = new_sum_func
            
            # Fade harmonic but keep sum visible
            self.play(FadeOut(harmonic_curve, run_time=0.4))
            
            # Periodic camera movements for emphasis
            if idx == 3:
                # Zoom to show approximation quality
                self.play(
                    self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(time_axes.get_center()).set(width=12),
                    run_time=2,
                    rate_func=smooth
                )
                self.wait(0.5)
                self.play(
                    self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set(width=16),
                    run_time=2,
                    rate_func=smooth
                )
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 4: Gibbs Phenomenon Deep Dive (6s)
        # ==========================================
        gibbs_title = Text("Gibbs Phenomenon: Non-uniform Convergence", font_size=28, color=ROSE)
        gibbs_title.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1.2)
        
        # Highlight discontinuity region
        discontinuity_point = time_axes.c2p(0, 0)
        zoom_region = Square(side_length=2, color=ROSE, stroke_width=2).move_to(discontinuity_point)
        
        self.play(
            Create(zoom_region, run_time=1),
            Write(gibbs_title, run_time=1)
        )
        
        # Zoom into Gibbs overshoot
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(discontinuity_point).set(width=3),
            run_time=2.5,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # Annotate overshoot
        overshoot_y = 4/np.pi * sum(1/n * np.sin(n*0.01) for n in range(1, 15, 2))  # Approximate peak
        overshoot_point = time_axes.c2p(0.05, 1.18)  # Gibbs constant ~1.1789797...
        
        dot = Dot(overshoot_point, color=ROSE, radius=0.08)
        label = MathTex(r"\approx 1.18", font_size=24, color=ROSE).next_to(dot, UR, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(dot, scale=2),
            Write(label),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # Return to wide view
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set(width=16),
            FadeOut(zoom_region),
            FadeOut(dot),
            FadeOut(label),
            FadeOut(gibbs_title),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # ==========================================
        # PHASE 5: Final Composition (4s)
        # ==========================================
        final_text = Text("Harmonic Superposition: n = 1 to 13", font_size=32, color=WHITE)
        final_text.to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        
        # Emphasize final curve
        glow_curve = time_axes.plot(current_sum_func, x_range=[-4, 4, 0.01], color=GOLD, stroke_width=8, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(glow_curve, run_time=1),
            FadeIn(final_text, run_time=1),
            Circumscribe(partial_sum_curve, run_time=1.5)
        )
        
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Elegant fade out
        self.play(
            FadeOut(time_axes),
            FadeOut(freq_axes),
            FadeOut(spectrum_bars),
            FadeOut(equation_terms),
            FadeOut(partial_sum_curve),
            FadeOut(glow_curve),
            FadeOut(target_curve),
            FadeOut(target_label),
            FadeOut(time_label),
            FadeOut(freq_label),
            FadeOut(x_label),
            FadeOut(y_label),
            FadeOut(n_label),
            FadeOut(amp_label),
            FadeOut(final_text),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

config.pixel_height = 1080
config.pixel_width = 1920
config.frame_rate = 60
config.background_color = "#0a0e17"

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.palette = {
            "primary": "#00f2ff",
            "secondary": "#ff0055",
            "accent": "#ffcc00",
            "success": "#00ff88",
            "text": "#ffffff",
            "muted": "#8899aa",
            "grid": "#1a2332",
            "deep_bg": "#050810"
        }
        
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = self.palette["deep_bg"]
        
        # Intro sequence
        self.play_intro()
        
        # Linear limitation
        self.demonstrate_linear_limitation()
        
        # Sigmoid
        self.explain_sigmoid()
        
        # Tanh
        self.explain_tanh()
        
        # ReLU
        self.explain_relu()
        
        # Leaky ReLU
        self.explain_leaky_relu()
        
        # Softmax
        self.explain_softmax()
        
        # Comparison finale
        self.final_comparison()
        
        # Outro
        self.play_outro()

    def create_styled_axes(self, x_range, y_range, height=6, width=10):
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            axis_config={
                "color": self.palette["muted"],
                "stroke_width": 2,
                "include_ticks": True,
                "tick_size": 0.05,
                "numbers_to_exclude": [],
            },
            x_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [x_range[0], 0, x_range[1]] if x_range[0] < 0 < x_range[1] else [x_range[0], x_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 0, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            y_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [y_range[0], 0, y_range[1]] if y_range[0] < 0 < y_range[1] else [y_range[0], y_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 1, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            tips=False
        )
        axes.set_stroke(opacity=0.6)
        
        grid = NumberPlane(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            background_line_style={
                "stroke_color": self.palette["grid"],
                "stroke_width": 1,
                "stroke_opacity": 0.3
            }
        )
        return VGroup(grid, axes), axes

    def play_intro(self):
        title = Text("ACTIVATION FUNCTIONS", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=72, color=self.palette["primary"])
        subtitle = Text("The Non-Linearity That Powers Deep Learning", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["muted"])
        
        title.move_to(ORIGIN)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        neural_bg = VGroup()
        for i in range(5):
            for j in range(4):
                node = Circle(radius=0.08, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=0, fill_color=self.palette["primary"])
                node.move_to(np.array([i*2-4, j*1.5-2.25, 0]))
                neural_bg.add(node)
                if i < 4 and j < 3:
                    line = Line(node.get_center(), node.get_center() + RIGHT*2 + UP*0.5, stroke_width=1, stroke_opacity=0.1, color=self.palette["primary"])
                    neural_bg.add(line)
        
        neural_bg.scale(1.5).set_opacity(0.2).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(neural_bg, run_time=2, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_cubic))
        self.play(Write(title, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.3, run_time=1.5))
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(title), FadeOut(subtitle), FadeOut(neural_bg))

    def demonstrate_linear_limitation(self):
        text_linear = Text("Without Activation: Linear Stacking", font="Montserrat", font_size=40, color=self.palette["text"])
        text_linear.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        axes1, ax1 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)
        axes1.shift(LEFT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        axes2, ax2 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)
        axes2.shift(RIGHT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        linear_func = lambda x: 0.5*x
        line1 = ax1.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        line2 = ax2.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        
        label1 = MathTex(r"f(x) = wx + b", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes1, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        label2 = MathTex(r"g(f(x)) = w'(wx+b)+b'", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes2, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        equals = Text("=", font="Montserrat", font_size=48, color=self.palette["muted"]).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN*0.5)
        still_linear = Text("Still Linear!", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(equals, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(text_linear, shift=DOWN*0.2), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes1), Create(line1, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label1))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        arrow = Arrow(axes1.get_right(), axes2.get_left(), color=self.palette["accent"], buff=0.3, stroke_width=3)
        stack_text = Text("Stack", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"]).next_to(arrow, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow), FadeIn(stack_text))
        self.play(FadeIn(axes2), Create(line2, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label2))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(equals), FadeIn(still_linear))
        self.wait(2)
        
        problem = Text("Solution: Introduce Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["success"])
        problem.next_to(still_linear, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(problem, shift=UP*0.3))
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(text_linear, axes1, axes2, line1, line2, label1, label2, arrow, stack_text, equals, still_linear, problem)))

    def explain_sigmoid(self):
        title = Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["primary"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}}", font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-6, 6], [0, 1.2], height=5, width=10)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        sigmoid_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-6, 6], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=5)
        
        asymptote_high = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 1), axes.c2p(6, 1), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        asymptote_low = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 0), axes.c2p(6, 0), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        
        label_0 = MathTex("0", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 0), DOWN+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        label_1 = MathTex("1", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 1), UP+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title, shift=RIGHT*0.3), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(sigmoid_curve, run_time=2.5, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_out_sine))
        self.play(FadeIn(asymptote_high), FadeIn(asymptote_low), FadeIn(label_0), FadeIn(label_1))
        
        features = VGroup(
            Text("• Smooth & Differentiable", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("• Output: (0, 1)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["text"]),
            Text("• Vanishing Gradient Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(features, lag_ratio=0.3, shift=RIGHT*0.2))
        self.wait(3)
        
        vanish_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(4, 0.98), axes.c2p(5, 0.99), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        vanish_text = Text("Gradient ≈ 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=20, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(vanish_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(vanish_arrow), FadeIn(vanish_text))
        self.wait(2)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, sigmoid_curve, asymptote_high, asymptote_low, 
                                label_0, label_1, features, vanish_arrow, vanish_text)))

    def explain_tanh(self):
        title = Text("Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["accent"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\tanh(x) = \frac{e^x - e^{-x}}{e^x + e^{-x}}", font_size=44, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-4, 4], [-1.2, 1.2], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        tanh_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x), x_range=[-4, 4], color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=5)
        
        comparison = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x))*2-1, x_range=[-4, 4], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        zero_line = DashedLine(axes.c2p(0, -1.2), axes.c2p(0, 1.2), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=1, dash_length=0.08)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), FadeIn(zero_line), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(comparison, run_time=1.5), rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_quad)
        self.play(Create(tanh_curve, run_time=2.5))
        
        sigmoid_ghost = MathTex(r"\sigma(x)", color=self.palette["primary"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.8), RIGHT)
        tanh_label = MathTex(r"\tanh(x)", color=self.palette["accent"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.5), RIGHT)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(sigmoid_ghost), FadeIn(tanh_label))
        
        zero_centered = Text("Zero-Centered: Aids Convergence", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["success"])
        zero_centered.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1)
        
        brace = Brace(Line(axes.c2p(0, -1), axes.c2p(0, 1)), direction=RIGHT, color=self.palette["success"])
        
        self.play(FadeIn(zero_centered, shift=UP*0.3), GrowFromCenter(brace))
        self.wait(2.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, tanh_curve, comparison, zero_line, 
                                sigmoid_ghost, tanh_label, zero_centered, brace)))

    def explain_relu(self):
        title = Text("ReLU (Rectified Linear Unit)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["success"])

from manim import *
import numpy as np

config.pixel_height = 1080
config.pixel_width = 1920
config.frame_rate = 60
config.background_color = "#0a0e17"

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.palette = {
            "primary": "#00f2ff",
            "secondary": "#ff0055",
            "accent": "#ffcc00",
            "success": "#00ff88",
            "text": "#ffffff",
            "muted": "#8899aa",
            "grid": "#1a2332",
            "deep_bg": "#050810"
        }
        
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = self.palette["deep_bg"]
        
        # Intro sequence
        self.play_intro()
        
        # Linear limitation
        self.demonstrate_linear_limitation()
        
        # Sigmoid
        self.explain_sigmoid()
        
        # Tanh
        self.explain_tanh()
        
        # ReLU
        self.explain_relu()
        
        # Leaky ReLU
        self.explain_leaky_relu()
        
        # Softmax
        self.explain_softmax()
        
        # Comparison finale
        self.final_comparison()
        
        # Outro
        self.play_outro()

    def create_styled_axes(self, x_range, y_range, height=6, width=10):
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            axis_config={
                "color": self.palette["muted"],
                "stroke_width": 2,
                "include_ticks": True,
                "tick_size": 0.05,
                "numbers_to_exclude": [],
            },
            x_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [x_range[0], 0, x_range[1]] if x_range[0] < 0 < x_range[1] else [x_range[0], x_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 0, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            y_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [y_range[0], 0, y_range[1]] if y_range[0] < 0 < y_range[1] else [y_range[0], y_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 1, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            tips=False
        )
        axes.set_stroke(opacity=0.6)
        
        grid = NumberPlane(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            background_line_style={
                "stroke_color": self.palette["grid"],
                "stroke_width": 1,
                "stroke_opacity": 0.3
            }
        )
        return VGroup(grid, axes), axes

    def play_intro(self):
        title = Text("ACTIVATION FUNCTIONS", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=72, color=self.palette["primary"])
        subtitle = Text("The Non-Linearity That Powers Deep Learning", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["muted"])
        
        title.move_to(ORIGIN)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        neural_bg = VGroup()
        for i in range(5):
            for j in range(4):
                node = Circle(radius=0.08, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=0, fill_color=self.palette["primary"])
                node.move_to(np.array([i*2-4, j*1.5-2.25, 0]))
                neural_bg.add(node)
                if i < 4 and j < 3:
                    line = Line(node.get_center(), node.get_center() + RIGHT*2 + UP*0.5, stroke_width=1, stroke_opacity=0.1, color=self.palette["primary"])
                    neural_bg.add(line)
        
        neural_bg.scale(1.5).set_opacity(0.2).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(neural_bg, run_time=2, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_cubic))
        self.play(Write(title, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.3, run_time=1.5))
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(title), FadeOut(subtitle), FadeOut(neural_bg))

    def demonstrate_linear_limitation(self):
        text_linear = Text("Without Activation: Linear Stacking", font="Montserrat", font_size=40, color=self.palette["text"])
        text_linear.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        axes1, ax1 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)
        axes1.shift(LEFT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)

        axes2.shift(RIGHT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        linear_func = lambda x: 0.5*x
        line1 = ax1.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        line2 = ax2.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        
        label1 = MathTex(r"f(x) = wx + b", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes1, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        label2 = MathTex(r"g(f(x)) = w'(wx+b)+b'", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes2, DOWN, buff=0.5)

        self.play(FadeIn(axes1), Create(line1, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label1))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        arrow = Arrow(axes1.get_right(), axes2.get_left(), color=self.palette["accent"], buff=0.3, stroke_width=3)
        stack_text = Text("Stack", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"]).next_to(arrow, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow), FadeIn(stack_text))
        self.play(FadeIn(axes2), Create(line2, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label2))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(equals), FadeIn(still_linear))
        self.wait(2)
        
        problem = Text("Solution: Introduce Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["success"])
        problem.next_to(still_linear, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(problem, shift=UP*0.3))
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(text_linear, axes1, axes2, line1, line2, label1, label2, arrow, stack_text, equals, still_linear, problem)))

    def explain_sigmoid(self):
        title = Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["primary"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}}", font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-6, 6], [0, 1.2], height=5, width=10)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        sigmoid_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-6, 6], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=5)
        
        asymptote_high = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 1), axes.c2p(6, 1), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        asymptote_low = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 0), axes.c2p(6, 0), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        
        label_0 = MathTex("0", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 0), DOWN+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        label_1 = MathTex("1", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 1), UP+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title, shift=RIGHT*0.3), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(sigmoid_curve, run_time=2.5, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_out_sine))
        self.play(FadeIn(asymptote_high), FadeIn(asymptote_low), FadeIn(label_0), FadeIn(label_1))
        
        features = VGroup(
            Text("• Smooth & Differentiable", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("• Output: (0, 1)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["text"]),
            Text("• Vanishing Gradient Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(features, lag_ratio=0.3, shift=RIGHT*0.2))
        self.wait(3)
        
        vanish_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(4, 0.98), axes.c2p(5, 0.99), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        vanish_text = Text("Gradient ≈ 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=20, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(vanish_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(vanish_arrow), FadeIn(vanish_text))
        self.wait(2)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, sigmoid_curve, asymptote_high, asymptote_low, 
                                label_0, label_1, features, vanish_arrow, vanish_text)))

    def explain_tanh(self):
        title = Text("Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["accent"])

        self.play(FadeIn(sigmoid_ghost), FadeIn(tanh_label))

            Text("✓ No Vanishing Gradient (for x > 0)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("✗ Dying ReLU Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.5).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*0.5)

    def explain_leaky_relu(self):

    def final_comparison(self):

        tanh_plot = axes.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x*1.5), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=3)

        legend = VGroup(
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=4), Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["primary"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3),
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=4), Text("Tanh", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3),
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=4), Text("ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["success"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3)
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(axes_group))
        
        self.play(Create(sigmoid_plot), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(tanh_plot), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(relu_plot), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(legend, lag_ratio=0.3))
        
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, axes_group, sigmoid_plot, tanh_plot, relu_plot, legend)))

    def play_outro(self):
        thanks = Text("The Power of Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=56, color=self.palette["primary"])
        sub = Text("Enabling Deep Neural Networks to Approximate Any Function", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["muted"])

        sub.next_to(thanks, DOWN, buff=0.6)

        self.play(FadeIn(sub, shift=UP*0.3), run_time=1))
        self.wait(2)
        
        universal_approx = MathTex(r"\text{Universal Approximation Theorem}", font_size=36, color=self.palette["accent"])
        universal_approx.next_to(sub, DOWN, buff=1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(universal_approx))
        self.wait(3)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

config.pixel_height = 1080
config.pixel_width = 1920
config.frame_rate = 60
config.background_color = "#0a0e17"

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.palette = {
            "primary": "#00f2ff",
            "secondary": "#ff0055",
            "accent": "#ffcc00",
            "success": "#00ff88",
            "text": "#ffffff",
            "muted": "#8899aa",
            "grid": "#1a2332",
            "deep_bg": "#050810"
        }
        
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = self.palette["deep_bg"]
        
        # Intro sequence
        self.play_intro()
        
        # Linear limitation
        self.demonstrate_linear_limitation()
        
        # Sigmoid
        self.explain_sigmoid()
        
        # Tanh
        self.explain_tanh()
        
        # ReLU
        self.explain_relu()
        
        # Leaky ReLU
        self.explain_leaky_relu()
        
        # Softmax
        self.explain_softmax()
        
        # Comparison finale
        self.final_comparison()
        
        # Outro
        self.play_outro()

    def create_styled_axes(self, x_range, y_range, height=6, width=10):
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            axis_config={
                "color": self.palette["muted"],
                "stroke_width": 2,
                "include_ticks": True,
                "tick_size": 0.05,
                "numbers_to_exclude": [],
            },
            x_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [x_range[0], 0, x_range[1]] if x_range[0] < 0 < x_range[1] else [x_range[0], x_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 0, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            y_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [y_range[0], 0, y_range[1]] if y_range[0] < 0 < y_range[1] else [y_range[0], y_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 1, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            tips=False
        )
        axes.set_stroke(opacity=0.6)
        
        grid = NumberPlane(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            background_line_style={
                "stroke_color": self.palette["grid"],
                "stroke_width": 1,
                "stroke_opacity": 0.3
            }
        )
        return VGroup(grid, axes), axes

    def play_intro(self):
        title = Text("ACTIVATION FUNCTIONS", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=72, color=self.palette["primary"])
        subtitle = Text("The Non-Linearity That Powers Deep Learning", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["muted"])
        
        title.move_to(ORIGIN)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        neural_bg = VGroup()
        for i in range(5):
            for j in range(4):
                node = Circle(radius=0.08, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=0, fill_color=self.palette["primary"])
                node.move_to(np.array([i*2-4, j*1.5-2.25, 0]))
                neural_bg.add(node)
                if i < 4 and j < 3:
                    line = Line(node.get_center(), node.get_center() + RIGHT*2 + UP*0.5, stroke_width=1, stroke_opacity=0.1, color=self.palette["primary"])
                    neural_bg.add(line)
        
        neural_bg.scale(1.5).set_opacity(0.2).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(neural_bg, run_time=2, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_cubic))
        self.play(Write(title, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.3, run_time=1.5))
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(title), FadeOut(subtitle), FadeOut(neural_bg))

    def demonstrate_linear_limitation(self):
        text_linear = Text("Without Activation: Linear Stacking", font="Montserrat", font_size=40, color=self.palette["text"])
        text_linear.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        axes1, ax1 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)
        axes1.shift(LEFT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        axes2, ax2 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)
        axes2.shift(RIGHT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        linear_func = lambda x: 0.5*x
        line1 = ax1.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        line2 = ax2.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        
        label1 = MathTex(r"f(x) = wx + b", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes1, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        label2 = MathTex(r"g(f(x)) = w'(wx+b)+b'", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes2, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        equals = Text("=", font="Montserrat", font_size=48, color=self.palette["muted"]).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN*0.5)
        still_linear = Text("Still Linear!", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(equals, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(text_linear, shift=DOWN*0.2), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes1), Create(line1, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label1))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        arrow = Arrow(axes1.get_right(), axes2.get_left(), color=self.palette["accent"], buff=0.3, stroke_width=3)
        stack_text = Text("Stack", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"]).next_to(arrow, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow), FadeIn(stack_text))
        self.play(FadeIn(axes2), Create(line2, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label2))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(equals), FadeIn(still_linear))
        self.wait(2)
        
        problem = Text("Solution: Introduce Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["success"])
        problem.next_to(still_linear, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(problem, shift=UP*0.3))
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(text_linear, axes1, axes2, line1, line2, label1, label2, arrow, stack_text, equals, still_linear, problem)))

    def explain_sigmoid(self):
        title = Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["primary"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}}", font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-6, 6], [0, 1.2], height=5, width=10)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        sigmoid_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-6, 6], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=5)
        
        asymptote_high = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 1), axes.c2p(6, 1), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        asymptote_low = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 0), axes.c2p(6, 0), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        
        label_0 = MathTex("0", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 0), DOWN+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        label_1 = MathTex("1", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 1), UP+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title, shift=RIGHT*0.3), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(sigmoid_curve, run_time=2.5, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_out_sine))
        self.play(FadeIn(asymptote_high), FadeIn(asymptote_low), FadeIn(label_0), FadeIn(label_1))
        
        features = VGroup(
            Text("• Smooth & Differentiable", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("• Output: (0, 1)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["text"]),
            Text("• Vanishing Gradient Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(features, lag_ratio=0.3, shift=RIGHT*0.2))
        self.wait(3)
        
        vanish_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(4, 0.98), axes.c2p(5, 0.99), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        vanish_text = Text("Gradient ≈ 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=20, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(vanish_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(vanish_arrow), FadeIn(vanish_text))
        self.wait(2)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, sigmoid_curve, asymptote_high, asymptote_low, 
                                label_0, label_1, features, vanish_arrow, vanish_text)))

    def explain_tanh(self):
        title = Text("Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["accent"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\tanh(x) = \frac{e^x - e^{-x}}{e^x + e^{-x}}", font_size=44, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-4, 4], [-1.2, 1.2], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        tanh_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x), x_range=[-4, 4], color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=5)
        
        comparison = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x))*2-1, x_range=[-4, 4], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        zero_line = DashedLine(axes.c2p(0, -1.2), axes.c2p(0, 1.2), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=1, dash_length=0.08)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), FadeIn(zero_line), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(comparison, run_time=1.5), rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_quad)
        self.play(Create(tanh_curve, run_time=2.5))
        
        sigmoid_ghost = MathTex(r"\sigma(x)", color=self.palette["primary"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.8), RIGHT)
        tanh_label = MathTex(r"\tanh(x)", color=self.palette["accent"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.5), RIGHT)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(sigmoid_ghost), FadeIn(tanh_label))
        
        zero_centered = Text("Zero-Centered: Aids Convergence", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["success"])
        zero_centered.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1)
        
        brace = Brace(Line(axes.c2p(0, -1), axes.c2p(0, 1)), direction=RIGHT, color=self.palette["success"])
        
        self.play(FadeIn(zero_centered, shift=UP*0.3), GrowFromCenter(brace))
        self.wait(2.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, tanh_curve, comparison, zero_line, 
                                sigmoid_ghost, tanh_label, zero_centered, brace)))

    def explain_relu(self):
        title = Text("ReLU (Rectified Linear Unit)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["success"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"f(x) = \max(0, x)", font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-0.5, 3], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        relu_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=6)
        
        gradient_region = Polygon(
            axes.c2p(0, 0), axes.c2p(3, 0), axes.c2p(3, 3), axes.c2p(0, 0),
            fill_color=self.palette["success"], fill_opacity=0.1, stroke_width=0
        )
        
        dead_region = Polygon(
            axes.c2p(-3, 0), axes.c2p(0, 0), axes.c2p(0, -0.5), axes.c2p(-3, -0.5),
            fill_color=self.palette["secondary"], fill_opacity=0.1, stroke_width=0
        )
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Create(relu_curve, run_time=2))
        
        self.play(FadeIn(gradient_region), FadeIn(dead_region))
        
        pros = VGroup(
            Text("✓ Computationally Efficient", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("✓ No Vanishing Gradient (for x > 0)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("✗ Dying ReLU Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.5).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(pros, lag_ratio=0.3))
        
        dead_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(-2, 0.2), axes.c2p(-1, 0.2), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        dead_text = Text("Gradient = 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(dead_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(dead_arrow), FadeIn(dead_text))
        self.wait(3)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, relu_curve, gradient_region, dead_region, pros, dead_arrow, dead_text)))

    def explain_leaky_relu(self):
        title = Text("Leaky ReLU", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["primary"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"f(x) = \max(\alpha x, x) \quad \alpha = 0.01", font_size=44, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-0.5, 3], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        alpha = 0.1  # exaggerated for visibility
        
        leaky_curve = VMobject()
        leaky_curve.set_points_as_corners([
            axes.c2p(-3, alpha * -3),
            axes.c2p(0, 0),
            axes.c2p(3, 3)
        ])
        leaky_curve.set_stroke(self.palette["primary"], width=6)
        
        relu_ghost = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        slope_label = MathTex(r"\alpha = 0.01", font_size=28, color=self.palette["muted"])
        slope_label.move_to(axes.c2p(-2, -0.3))

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), FadeIn(relu_ghost), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Create(leaky_curve, run_time=2))
        self.play(FadeIn(slope_label), FadeIn(fix_text, shift=UP*0.3))
        self.wait(2.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, leaky_curve, relu_ghost, slope_label, fix_text)))

    def explain_softmax(self):
        title = Text("Softmax (Multi-Class Classification)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=44, color=self.palette["accent"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\sigma(z_i) = \frac{e^{z_i}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K} e^{z_j}}", font_size=40, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)

        labels = VGroup()
        values = [2.0, 1.0, 0.5, 0.1]
        colors = [self.palette["primary"], self.palette["secondary"], self.palette["accent"], self.palette["success"]]
        
        exp_vals = [np.exp(v) for v in values]
        sum_exp = sum(exp_vals)
        probs = [v/sum_exp for v in exp_vals]
        
        for i, (val, prob, color) in enumerate(zip(values, probs, colors)):
            bar = Rectangle(height=prob*4, width=1.2, fill_color=color, fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_width=2, stroke_color=color)
            bar.move_to(DOWN*2 + LEFT*3 + RIGHT*i*2)
            bars.add(bar)
            
            input_val = MathTex(f"z_{i+1}={val}", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(bar, DOWN, buff=0.3)
            output_val = MathTex(f"{prob:.2f}", font_size=28, color=self.palette["text"]).next_to(bar, UP, buff=0.2)
            labels.add(VGroup(input_val, output_val))
        
        sum_text = MathTex(r"\sum = 1.0", font_size=32, color=self.palette["success"]).next_to(bars, RIGHT, buff=1)

        self.play(FadeIn(bars, lag_ratio=0.2, shift=UP*0.5), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(labels, lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=1)
        self.play(FadeIn(sum_text), FadeIn(arrows))
        
        props = Text("Properties: Probabilities sum to 1, Differentiable", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["text"])
        props.next_to(formula, DOWN, buff=1.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(props))
        self.wait(2.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, bars, labels, sum_text, arrows, props)))

    def final_comparison(self):
        title = Text("Function Comparison", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-1.5, 2], height=4, width=12)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        sigmoid_plot = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x*2)), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=3)
        tanh_plot = axes.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x*1.5), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=3)
        relu_plot = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), x_range=[-1.5, 2], color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=3)
        
        legend = VGroup(
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=4), Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["primary"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3),
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=4), Text("Tanh", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3),
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=4), Text("ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["success"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3)
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(axes_group))
        
        self.play(Create(sigmoid_plot), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(tanh_plot), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(relu_plot), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(legend, lag_ratio=0.3))
        
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, axes_group, sigmoid_plot, tanh_plot, relu_plot, legend)))

    def play_outro(self):
        thanks = Text("The Power of Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=56, color=self.palette["primary"])
        sub = Text("Enabling Deep Neural Networks to Approximate Any Function", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["muted"])
        
        thanks.move_to(ORIGIN)
        sub.next_to(thanks, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(thanks, scale=0.9), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(sub, shift=UP*0.3), run_time=1))
        self.wait(2)
        
        universal_approx = MathTex(r"\text{Universal Approximation Theorem}", font_size=36, color=self.palette["accent"])
        universal_approx.next_to(sub, DOWN, buff=1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(universal_approx))
        self.wait(3)
