from manim import *
import numpy as np

config.pixel_height = 1080
config.pixel_width = 1920
config.frame_rate = 60
config.background_color = "#0a0e17"

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.palette = {
            "primary": "#00f2ff",
            "secondary": "#ff0055",
            "accent": "#ffcc00",
            "success": "#00ff88",
            "text": "#ffffff",
            "muted": "#8899aa",
            "grid": "#1a2332",
            "deep_bg": "#050810"
        }
        
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = self.palette["deep_bg"]
        
        # Intro sequence
        self.play_intro()
        
        # Linear limitation
        self.demonstrate_linear_limitation()
        
        # Sigmoid
        self.explain_sigmoid()
        
        # Tanh
        self.explain_tanh()
        
        # ReLU
        self.explain_relu()
        
        # Leaky ReLU
        self.explain_leaky_relu()
        
        # Softmax
        self.explain_softmax()
        
        # Comparison finale
        self.final_comparison()
        
        # Outro
        self.play_outro()

    def create_styled_axes(self, x_range, y_range, height=6, width=10):
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            axis_config={
                "color": self.palette["muted"],
                "stroke_width": 2,
                "include_ticks": True,
                "tick_size": 0.05,
                "numbers_to_exclude": [],
            },
            x_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [x_range[0], 0, x_range[1]] if x_range[0] < 0 < x_range[1] else [x_range[0], x_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 0, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            y_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [y_range[0], 0, y_range[1]] if y_range[0] < 0 < y_range[1] else [y_range[0], y_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 1, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            tips=False
        )
        axes.set_stroke(opacity=0.6)
        
        grid = NumberPlane(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            background_line_style={
                "stroke_color": self.palette["grid"],
                "stroke_width": 1,
                "stroke_opacity": 0.3
            }
        )
        return VGroup(grid, axes), axes

    def play_intro(self):
        title = Text("ACTIVATION FUNCTIONS", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=72, color=self.palette["primary"])
        subtitle = Text("The Non-Linearity That Powers Deep Learning", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["muted"])
        
        title.move_to(ORIGIN)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        neural_bg = VGroup()
        for i in range(5):
            for j in range(4):
                node = Circle(radius=0.08, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=0, fill_color=self.palette["primary"])
                node.move_to(np.array([i*2-4, j*1.5-2.25, 0]))
                neural_bg.add(node)
                if i < 4 and j < 3:
                    line = Line(node.get_center(), node.get_center() + RIGHT*2 + UP*0.5, stroke_width=1, stroke_opacity=0.1, color=self.palette["primary"])
                    neural_bg.add(line)
        
        neural_bg.scale(1.5).set_opacity(0.2).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(neural_bg, run_time=2, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_cubic))
        self.play(Write(title, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.3, run_time=1.5))
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(title), FadeOut(subtitle), FadeOut(neural_bg))

    def demonstrate_linear_limitation(self):
        text_linear = Text("Without Activation: Linear Stacking", font="Montserrat", font_size=40, color=self.palette["text"])
        text_linear.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        axes1, ax1 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)
        axes1.shift(LEFT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        axes2, ax2 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)
        axes2.shift(RIGHT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        linear_func = lambda x: 0.5*x
        line1 = ax1.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        line2 = ax2.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        
        label1 = MathTex(r"f(x) = wx + b", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes1, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        label2 = MathTex(r"g(f(x)) = w'(wx+b)+b'", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes2, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        equals = Text("=", font="Montserrat", font_size=48, color=self.palette["muted"]).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN*0.5)
        still_linear = Text("Still Linear!", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(equals, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(text_linear, shift=DOWN*0.2), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes1), Create(line1, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label1))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        arrow = Arrow(axes1.get_right(), axes2.get_left(), color=self.palette["accent"], buff=0.3, stroke_width=3)
        stack_text = Text("Stack", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"]).next_to(arrow, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow), FadeIn(stack_text))
        self.play(FadeIn(axes2), Create(line2, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label2))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(equals), FadeIn(still_linear))
        self.wait(2)
        
        problem = Text("Solution: Introduce Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["success"])
        problem.next_to(still_linear, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(problem, shift=UP*0.3))
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(text_linear, axes1, axes2, line1, line2, label1, label2, arrow, stack_text, equals, still_linear, problem)))

    def explain_sigmoid(self):
        title = Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["primary"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}}", font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-6, 6], [0, 1.2], height=5, width=10)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        sigmoid_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-6, 6], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=5)
        
        asymptote_high = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 1), axes.c2p(6, 1), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        asymptote_low = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 0), axes.c2p(6, 0), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        
        label_0 = MathTex("0", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 0), DOWN+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        label_1 = MathTex("1", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 1), UP+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title, shift=RIGHT*0.3), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(sigmoid_curve, run_time=2.5, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_out_sine))
        self.play(FadeIn(asymptote_high), FadeIn(asymptote_low), FadeIn(label_0), FadeIn(label_1))
        
        features = VGroup(
            Text("• Smooth & Differentiable", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("• Output: (0, 1)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["text"]),
            Text("• Vanishing Gradient Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(features, lag_ratio=0.3, shift=RIGHT*0.2))
        self.wait(3)
        
        vanish_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(4, 0.98), axes.c2p(5, 0.99), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        vanish_text = Text("Gradient ≈ 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=20, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(vanish_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(vanish_arrow), FadeIn(vanish_text))
        self.wait(2)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, sigmoid_curve, asymptote_high, asymptote_low, 
                                label_0, label_1, features, vanish_arrow, vanish_text)))

    def explain_tanh(self):
        title = Text("Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["accent"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\tanh(x) = \frac{e^x - e^{-x}}{e^x + e^{-x}}", font_size=44, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-4, 4], [-1.2, 1.2], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        tanh_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x), x_range=[-4, 4], color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=5)
        
        comparison = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x))*2-1, x_range=[-4, 4], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        zero_line = DashedLine(axes.c2p(0, -1.2), axes.c2p(0, 1.2), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=1, dash_length=0.08)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), FadeIn(zero_line), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(comparison, run_time=1.5), rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_quad)
        self.play(Create(tanh_curve, run_time=2.5))
        
        sigmoid_ghost = MathTex(r"\sigma(x)", color=self.palette["primary"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.8), RIGHT)
        tanh_label = MathTex(r"\tanh(x)", color=self.palette["accent"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.5), RIGHT)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(sigmoid_ghost), FadeIn(tanh_label))
        
        zero_centered = Text("Zero-Centered: Aids Convergence", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["success"])
        zero_centered.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1)
        
        brace = Brace(Line(axes.c2p(0, -1), axes.c2p(0, 1)), direction=RIGHT, color=self.palette["success"])
        
        self.play(FadeIn(zero_centered, shift=UP*0.3), GrowFromCenter(brace))
        self.wait(2.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, tanh_curve, comparison, zero_line, 
                                sigmoid_ghost, tanh_label, zero_centered, brace)))

    def explain_relu(self):
        title = Text("ReLU (Rectified Linear Unit)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["success"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"f(x) = \max(0, x)", font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-0.5, 3], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        relu_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=6)
        
        gradient_region = Polygon(
            axes.c2p(0, 0), axes.c2p(3, 0), axes.c2p(3, 3), axes.c2p(0, 0),
            fill_color=self.palette["success"], fill_opacity=0.1, stroke_width=0
        )
        
        dead_region = Polygon(
            axes.c2p(-3, 0), axes.c2p(0, 0), axes.c2p(0, -0.5), axes.c2p(-3, -0.5),
            fill_color=self.palette["secondary"], fill_opacity=0.1, stroke_width=0
        )
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Create(relu_curve, run_time=2))
        
        self.play(FadeIn(gradient_region), FadeIn(dead_region))
        
        pros = VGroup(
            Text("✓ Computationally Efficient", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("✓ No Vanishing Gradient (for x > 0)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("✗ Dying ReLU Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.5).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(pros, lag_ratio=0.3))
        
        dead_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(-2, 0.2), axes.c2p(-1, 0.2), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        dead_text = Text("Gradient = 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(dead_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(dead_arrow), FadeIn(dead_text))
        self.wait(3)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, relu_curve, gradient_region, dead_region, pros, dead_arrow, dead_text)))

    def explain_leaky_relu(self):

    def final_comparison(self):

        legend = VGroup(
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=4), Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["primary"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3),
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=4), Text("Tanh", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3),
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=4), Text("ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["success"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3)
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(axes_group))

    def play_outro(self):
        thanks = Text("The Power of Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=56, color=self.palette["primary"])

        universal_approx.next_to(sub, DOWN, buff=1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(universal_approx))
        self.wait(3)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

config.pixel_height = 1080
config.pixel_width = 1920
config.frame_rate = 60
config.background_color = "#0a0e17"

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.palette = {
            "primary": "#00f2ff",
            "secondary": "#ff0055",
            "accent": "#ffcc00",
            "success": "#00ff88",
            "text": "#ffffff",
            "muted": "#8899aa",
            "grid": "#1a2332",
            "deep_bg": "#050810"
        }
        
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = self.palette["deep_bg"]
        
        # Intro sequence
        self.play_intro()
        
        # Linear limitation
        self.demonstrate_linear_limitation()
        
        # Sigmoid
        self.explain_sigmoid()
        
        # Tanh
        self.explain_tanh()
        
        # ReLU
        self.explain_relu()
        
        # Leaky ReLU
        self.explain_leaky_relu()
        
        # Softmax
        self.explain_softmax()
        
        # Comparison finale
        self.final_comparison()
        
        # Outro
        self.play_outro()

    def create_styled_axes(self, x_range, y_range, height=6, width=10):
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            axis_config={
                "color": self.palette["muted"],
                "stroke_width": 2,
                "include_ticks": True,
                "tick_size": 0.05,
                "numbers_to_exclude": [],
            },
            x_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [x_range[0], 0, x_range[1]] if x_range[0] < 0 < x_range[1] else [x_range[0], x_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 0, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            y_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [y_range[0], 0, y_range[1]] if y_range[0] < 0 < y_range[1] else [y_range[0], y_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 1, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            tips=False
        )
        axes.set_stroke(opacity=0.6)
        
        grid = NumberPlane(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            background_line_style={
                "stroke_color": self.palette["grid"],
                "stroke_width": 1,
                "stroke_opacity": 0.3
            }
        )
        return VGroup(grid, axes), axes

    def play_intro(self):
        title = Text("ACTIVATION FUNCTIONS", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=72, color=self.palette["primary"])
        subtitle = Text("The Non-Linearity That Powers Deep Learning", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["muted"])
        
        title.move_to(ORIGIN)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        neural_bg = VGroup()
        for i in range(5):
            for j in range(4):
                node = Circle(radius=0.08, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=0, fill_color=self.palette["primary"])
                node.move_to(np.array([i*2-4, j*1.5-2.25, 0]))
                neural_bg.add(node)
                if i < 4 and j < 3:
                    line = Line(node.get_center(), node.get_center() + RIGHT*2 + UP*0.5, stroke_width=1, stroke_opacity=0.1, color=self.palette["primary"])
                    neural_bg.add(line)
        
        neural_bg.scale(1.5).set_opacity(0.2).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(neural_bg, run_time=2, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_cubic))
        self.play(Write(title, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.3, run_time=1.5))
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(title), FadeOut(subtitle), FadeOut(neural_bg))

    def demonstrate_linear_limitation(self):
        text_linear = Text("Without Activation: Linear Stacking", font="Montserrat", font_size=40, color=self.palette["text"])
        text_linear.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        axes1, ax1 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)

        line1 = ax1.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        line2 = ax2.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        
        label1 = MathTex(r"f(x) = wx + b", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes1, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        label2 = MathTex(r"g(f(x)) = w'(wx+b)+b'", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes2, DOWN, buff=0.5)

        self.play(FadeIn(text_linear, shift=DOWN*0.2), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes1), Create(line1, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label1))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        arrow = Arrow(axes1.get_right(), axes2.get_left(), color=self.palette["accent"], buff=0.3, stroke_width=3)
        stack_text = Text("Stack", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"]).next_to(arrow, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow), FadeIn(stack_text))
        self.play(FadeIn(axes2), Create(line2, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label2))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(equals), FadeIn(still_linear))
        self.wait(2)
        
        problem = Text("Solution: Introduce Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["success"])
        problem.next_to(still_linear, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(problem, shift=UP*0.3))
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(text_linear, axes1, axes2, line1, line2, label1, label2, arrow, stack_text, equals, still_linear, problem)))

    def explain_sigmoid(self):
        title = Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["primary"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}}", font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-6, 6], [0, 1.2], height=5, width=10)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        sigmoid_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-6, 6], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=5)
        
        asymptote_high = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 1), axes.c2p(6, 1), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        asymptote_low = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 0), axes.c2p(6, 0), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        
        label_0 = MathTex("0", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 0), DOWN+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        label_1 = MathTex("1", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 1), UP+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title, shift=RIGHT*0.3), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(sigmoid_curve, run_time=2.5, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_out_sine))
        self.play(FadeIn(asymptote_high), FadeIn(asymptote_low), FadeIn(label_0), FadeIn(label_1))
        
        features = VGroup(
            Text("• Smooth & Differentiable", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("• Output: (0, 1)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["text"]),
            Text("• Vanishing Gradient Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(features, lag_ratio=0.3, shift=RIGHT*0.2))
        self.wait(3)
        
        vanish_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(4, 0.98), axes.c2p(5, 0.99), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        vanish_text = Text("Gradient ≈ 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=20, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(vanish_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(vanish_arrow), FadeIn(vanish_text))
        self.wait(2)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, sigmoid_curve, asymptote_high, asymptote_low, 
                                label_0, label_1, features, vanish_arrow, vanish_text)))

    def explain_tanh(self):
        title = Text("Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["accent"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)

        comparison = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x))*2-1, x_range=[-4, 4], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        zero_line = DashedLine(axes.c2p(0, -1.2), axes.c2p(0, 1.2), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=1, dash_length=0.08)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), FadeIn(zero_line), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(comparison, run_time=1.5), rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_quad)
        self.play(Create(tanh_curve, run_time=2.5))
        
        sigmoid_ghost = MathTex(r"\sigma(x)", color=self.palette["primary"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.8), RIGHT)
        tanh_label = MathTex(r"\tanh(x)", color=self.palette["accent"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.5), RIGHT)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(sigmoid_ghost), FadeIn(tanh_label))

        zero_centered.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1)

        )
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=0.8)

        self.play(FadeIn(gradient_region), FadeIn(dead_region))
        
        pros = VGroup(
            Text("✓ Computationally Efficient", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("✓ No Vanishing Gradient (for x > 0)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("✗ Dying ReLU Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.5).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(pros, lag_ratio=0.3))
        
        dead_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(-2, 0.2), axes.c2p(-1, 0.2), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        dead_text = Text("Gradient = 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(dead_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(dead_arrow), FadeIn(dead_text))
        self.wait(3)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, relu_curve, gradient_region, dead_region, pros, dead_arrow, dead_text)))

    def explain_leaky_relu(self):
        title = Text("Leaky ReLU", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["primary"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"f(x) = \max(\alpha x, x) \quad \alpha = 0.01", font_size=44, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-0.5, 3], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)

        ])
        leaky_curve.set_stroke(self.palette["primary"], width=6)
        
        relu_ghost = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        slope_label = MathTex(r"\alpha = 0.01", font_size=28, color=self.palette["muted"])
        slope_label.move_to(axes.c2p(-2, -0.3))
        
        fix_text = Text("Fixes Dying ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["accent"])
        fix_text.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), FadeIn(relu_ghost), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Create(leaky_curve, run_time=2))
        self.play(FadeIn(slope_label), FadeIn(fix_text, shift=UP*0.3))
        self.wait(2.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, leaky_curve, relu_ghost, slope_label, fix_text)))

    def explain_softmax(self):

        exp_vals = [np.exp(v) for v in values]
        sum_exp = sum(exp_vals)
        probs = [v/sum_exp for v in exp_vals]
        
        for i, (val, prob, color) in enumerate(zip(values, probs, colors)):
            bar = Rectangle(height=prob*4, width=1.2, fill_color=color, fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_width=2, stroke_color=color)

            labels.add(VGroup(input_val, output_val))
        
        sum_text = MathTex(r"\sum = 1.0", font_size=32, color=self.palette["success"]).next_to(bars, RIGHT, buff=1)

    def final_comparison(self):

        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.6)

        sigmoid_plot = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x*2)), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=3)
        tanh_plot = axes.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x*1.5), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=3)
        relu_plot = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), x_range=[-1.5, 2], color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=3)
        
        legend = VGroup(
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=4), Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["primary"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3),
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=4), Text("Tanh", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3),
            VGroup(Line(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=4), Text("ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["success"])).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3)
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(axes_group))
        
        self.play(Create(sigmoid_plot), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(tanh_plot), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(relu_plot), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(legend, lag_ratio=0.3))
        
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, axes_group, sigmoid_plot, tanh_plot, relu_plot, legend)))

    def play_outro(self):
        thanks = Text("The Power of Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=56, color=self.palette["primary"])
        sub = Text("Enabling Deep Neural Networks to Approximate Any Function", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["muted"])
        
        thanks.move_to(ORIGIN)
        sub.next_to(thanks, DOWN, buff=0.6)

        self.play(FadeIn(sub, shift=UP*0.3), run_time=1))
        self.wait(2)
        
        universal_approx = MathTex(r"\text{Universal Approximation Theorem}", font_size=36, color=self.palette["accent"])
        universal_approx.next_to(sub, DOWN, buff=1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(universal_approx))
        self.wait(3)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

config.pixel_height = 1080
config.pixel_width = 1920
config.frame_rate = 60
config.background_color = "#0a0e17"

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.palette = {
            "primary": "#00f2ff",
            "secondary": "#ff0055",
            "accent": "#ffcc00",
            "success": "#00ff88",
            "text": "#ffffff",
            "muted": "#8899aa",
            "grid": "#1a2332",
            "deep_bg": "#050810"
        }
        
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = self.palette["deep_bg"]
        
        # Intro sequence
        self.play_intro()
        
        # Linear limitation
        self.demonstrate_linear_limitation()
        
        # Sigmoid
        self.explain_sigmoid()
        
        # Tanh
        self.explain_tanh()
        
        # ReLU
        self.explain_relu()
        
        # Leaky ReLU
        self.explain_leaky_relu()
        
        # Softmax
        self.explain_softmax()
        
        # Comparison finale
        self.final_comparison()
        
        # Outro
        self.play_outro()

    def create_styled_axes(self, x_range, y_range, height=6, width=10):
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            axis_config={
                "color": self.palette["muted"],
                "stroke_width": 2,
                "include_ticks": True,
                "tick_size": 0.05,
                "numbers_to_exclude": [],
            },
            x_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [x_range[0], 0, x_range[1]] if x_range[0] < 0 < x_range[1] else [x_range[0], x_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 0, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            y_axis_config={
                "numbers_to_include": [y_range[0], 0, y_range[1]] if y_range[0] < 0 < y_range[1] else [y_range[0], y_range[1]],
                "decimal_number_config": {"num_decimal_places": 1, "color": self.palette["muted"], "font_size": 24}
            },
            tips=False
        )
        axes.set_stroke(opacity=0.6)
        
        grid = NumberPlane(
            x_range=x_range,
            y_range=y_range,
            x_length=width,
            y_length=height,
            background_line_style={
                "stroke_color": self.palette["grid"],
                "stroke_width": 1,
                "stroke_opacity": 0.3
            }
        )
        return VGroup(grid, axes), axes

    def play_intro(self):
        title = Text("ACTIVATION FUNCTIONS", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=72, color=self.palette["primary"])
        subtitle = Text("The Non-Linearity That Powers Deep Learning", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["muted"])
        
        title.move_to(ORIGIN)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        neural_bg = VGroup()
        for i in range(5):
            for j in range(4):
                node = Circle(radius=0.08, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_width=0, fill_color=self.palette["primary"])
                node.move_to(np.array([i*2-4, j*1.5-2.25, 0]))
                neural_bg.add(node)
                if i < 4 and j < 3:
                    line = Line(node.get_center(), node.get_center() + RIGHT*2 + UP*0.5, stroke_width=1, stroke_opacity=0.1, color=self.palette["primary"])
                    neural_bg.add(line)
        
        neural_bg.scale(1.5).set_opacity(0.2).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(neural_bg, run_time=2, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_cubic))
        self.play(Write(title, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.3, run_time=1.5))
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(title), FadeOut(subtitle), FadeOut(neural_bg))

    def demonstrate_linear_limitation(self):
        text_linear = Text("Without Activation: Linear Stacking", font="Montserrat", font_size=40, color=self.palette["text"])
        text_linear.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        axes1, ax1 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)
        axes1.shift(LEFT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        axes2, ax2 = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-2, 2], height=4, width=5)
        axes2.shift(RIGHT*3.5 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        linear_func = lambda x: 0.5*x
        line1 = ax1.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        line2 = ax2.plot(linear_func, x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["secondary"], stroke_width=4)
        
        label1 = MathTex(r"f(x) = wx + b", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes1, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        label2 = MathTex(r"g(f(x)) = w'(wx+b)+b'", color=self.palette["text"], font_size=36).next_to(axes2, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        equals = Text("=", font="Montserrat", font_size=48, color=self.palette["muted"]).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN*0.5)
        still_linear = Text("Still Linear!", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(equals, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(text_linear, shift=DOWN*0.2), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes1), Create(line1, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label1))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        arrow = Arrow(axes1.get_right(), axes2.get_left(), color=self.palette["accent"], buff=0.3, stroke_width=3)
        stack_text = Text("Stack", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["accent"]).next_to(arrow, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow), FadeIn(stack_text))
        self.play(FadeIn(axes2), Create(line2, run_time=1.5), FadeIn(label2))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(equals), FadeIn(still_linear))
        self.wait(2)
        
        problem = Text("Solution: Introduce Non-Linearity", font="Montserrat", font_size=36, color=self.palette["success"])
        problem.next_to(still_linear, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(problem, shift=UP*0.3))
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(text_linear, axes1, axes2, line1, line2, label1, label2, arrow, stack_text, equals, still_linear, problem)))

    def explain_sigmoid(self):
        title = Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["primary"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}}", font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-6, 6], [0, 1.2], height=5, width=10)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        sigmoid_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-6, 6], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=5)
        
        asymptote_high = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 1), axes.c2p(6, 1), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        asymptote_low = DashedLine(axes.c2p(-6, 0), axes.c2p(6, 0), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=2, dash_length=0.1)
        
        label_0 = MathTex("0", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 0), DOWN+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        label_1 = MathTex("1", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(axes.c2p(0, 1), UP+LEFT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title, shift=RIGHT*0.3), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula), run_time=1.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(sigmoid_curve, run_time=2.5, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_out_sine))
        self.play(FadeIn(asymptote_high), FadeIn(asymptote_low), FadeIn(label_0), FadeIn(label_1))
        
        features = VGroup(
            Text("• Smooth & Differentiable", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("• Output: (0, 1)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["text"]),
            Text("• Vanishing Gradient Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(features, lag_ratio=0.3, shift=RIGHT*0.2))
        self.wait(3)
        
        vanish_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(4, 0.98), axes.c2p(5, 0.99), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        vanish_text = Text("Gradient ≈ 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=20, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(vanish_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(vanish_arrow), FadeIn(vanish_text))
        self.wait(2)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, sigmoid_curve, asymptote_high, asymptote_low, 
                                label_0, label_1, features, vanish_arrow, vanish_text)))

    def explain_tanh(self):
        title = Text("Hyperbolic Tangent (Tanh)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["accent"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\tanh(x) = \frac{e^x - e^{-x}}{e^x + e^{-x}}", font_size=44, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-4, 4], [-1.2, 1.2], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        tanh_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x), x_range=[-4, 4], color=self.palette["accent"], stroke_width=5)
        
        comparison = axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x))*2-1, x_range=[-4, 4], color=self.palette["primary"], stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        zero_line = DashedLine(axes.c2p(0, -1.2), axes.c2p(0, 1.2), color=self.palette["muted"], stroke_width=1, dash_length=0.08)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), FadeIn(zero_line), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(Create(comparison, run_time=1.5), rate_func=rate_functions.ease_out_quad)
        self.play(Create(tanh_curve, run_time=2.5))
        
        sigmoid_ghost = MathTex(r"\sigma(x)", color=self.palette["primary"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.8), RIGHT)
        tanh_label = MathTex(r"\tanh(x)", color=self.palette["accent"], font_size=24).next_to(axes.c2p(2, 0.5), RIGHT)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(sigmoid_ghost), FadeIn(tanh_label))
        
        zero_centered = Text("Zero-Centered: Aids Convergence", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["success"])
        zero_centered.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1)
        
        brace = Brace(Line(axes.c2p(0, -1), axes.c2p(0, 1)), direction=RIGHT, color=self.palette["success"])
        
        self.play(FadeIn(zero_centered, shift=UP*0.3), GrowFromCenter(brace))
        self.wait(2.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, tanh_curve, comparison, zero_line, 
                                sigmoid_ghost, tanh_label, zero_centered, brace)))

    def explain_relu(self):
        title = Text("ReLU (Rectified Linear Unit)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["success"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"f(x) = \max(0, x)", font_size=48, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-0.5, 3], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        relu_curve = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=6)
        
        gradient_region = Polygon(
            axes.c2p(0, 0), axes.c2p(3, 0), axes.c2p(3, 3), axes.c2p(0, 0),
            fill_color=self.palette["success"], fill_opacity=0.1, stroke_width=0
        )
        
        dead_region = Polygon(
            axes.c2p(-3, 0), axes.c2p(0, 0), axes.c2p(0, -0.5), axes.c2p(-3, -0.5),
            fill_color=self.palette["secondary"], fill_opacity=0.1, stroke_width=0
        )
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Create(relu_curve, run_time=2))
        
        self.play(FadeIn(gradient_region), FadeIn(dead_region))
        
        pros = VGroup(
            Text("✓ Computationally Efficient", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("✓ No Vanishing Gradient (for x > 0)", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["success"]),
            Text("✗ Dying ReLU Problem", font="Montserrat", font_size=28, color=self.palette["secondary"])
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.5).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(pros, lag_ratio=0.3))
        
        dead_arrow = Arrow(axes.c2p(-2, 0.2), axes.c2p(-1, 0.2), color=self.palette["secondary"], buff=0)
        dead_text = Text("Gradient = 0", font="Montserrat", font_size=24, color=self.palette["secondary"]).next_to(dead_arrow, UP)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(dead_arrow), FadeIn(dead_text))
        self.wait(3)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, relu_curve, gradient_region, dead_region, pros, dead_arrow, dead_text)))

    def explain_leaky_relu(self):
        title = Text("Leaky ReLU", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=48, color=self.palette["primary"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"f(x) = \max(\alpha x, x) \quad \alpha = 0.01", font_size=44, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        axes_group, axes = self.create_styled_axes([-3, 3], [-0.5, 3], height=5, width=8)
        axes_group.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        alpha = 0.1  # exaggerated for visibility
        
        leaky_curve = VMobject()
        leaky_curve.set_points_as_corners([
            axes.c2p(-3, alpha * -3),
            axes.c2p(0, 0),
            axes.c2p(3, 3)
        ])
        leaky_curve.set_stroke(self.palette["primary"], width=6)
        
        relu_ghost = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), x_range=[-3, 3], color=self.palette["success"], stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.3)
        
        slope_label = MathTex(r"\alpha = 0.01", font_size=28, color=self.palette["muted"])
        slope_label.move_to(axes.c2p(-2, -0.3))
        
        fix_text = Text("Fixes Dying ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color=self.palette["accent"])
        fix_text.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Write(formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(axes_group), FadeIn(relu_ghost), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Create(leaky_curve, run_time=2))
        self.play(FadeIn(slope_label), FadeIn(fix_text, shift=UP*0.3))
        self.wait(2.5)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(VGroup(title, formula, axes_group, leaky_curve, relu_ghost, slope_label, fix_text)))

    def explain_softmax(self):
        title = Text("Softmax (Multi-Class Classification)", font="Montserrat", weight=BOLD, font_size=44, color=self.palette["accent"])
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.8)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\sigma(z_i) = \frac{e^{z_i}}{\sum_{j=1}^{K} e^{z_j}}", font_size=40, color=self.palette["text"])
        formula.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        bars = VGroup()
        labels = VGroup()
        values = [2.0, 1.0, 0.5, 0.1]
        colors = [self.palette["primary"], self.palette["secondary"], self.palette["accent"], self.palette["success"]]
        
        exp_vals = [np.exp(v) for v in values]
        sum_exp = sum(exp_vals)
        probs = [v/sum_exp for v in exp_vals]
        
        for i, (val, prob, color) in enumerate(zip(values, probs, colors)):
            bar = Rectangle(height=prob*4, width=1.2, fill_color=color, fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_width=2, stroke_color=color)
            bar.move_to(DOWN*2 + LEFT*3 + RIGHT*i*2)
            bars.add(bar)
            
            input_val = MathTex(f"z_{i+1}={val}", font_size=24, color=self.palette["muted"]).next_to(bar, DOWN, buff=0.3)
            output_val = MathTex(f"{prob:.2f}", font_size=28, color=self.palette["text"]).next_to(bar, UP, buff=0.2)
            labels.add(VGroup(input_val, output_val))
        
        sum_text = MathTex(r"\sum = 1.0", font_size=32, color=self.palette["success"]).next_to(bars, RIGHT, buff=1)
        
        arrows = VGroup(*[Arrow(UP*0.5, DOWN*0.5, color=self.palette["muted"], buff=0).next_to(bar, UP, buff=0.5) for bar in bars])

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def setup(self):
        self.camera.frame.set_width(20)
        self.camera.frame.set_height(11.25)
        self.camera.frame.move_to(ORIGIN)
        
    def create_glow(self, mobject, color=YELLOW, radius=0.3, opacity=0.3):
        glow = VGroup()
        for i in range(3):
            circle = Circle(
                radius=radius * (1 + i * 0.3),
                stroke_width=0,
                fill_color=color,
                fill_opacity=opacity * (0.5 ** i)
            ).move_to(mobject.get_center())
            glow.add(circle)
        return glow
    
    def create_neon_vector(self, start, end, color=CYAN, stroke_width=6, tip_length=0.25):
        vector = Arrow(
            start=start, 
            end=end, 
            buff=0,
            color=color,
            stroke_width=stroke_width,
            max_tip_length_to_length_ratio=tip_length
        )
        glow = self.create_glow(vector, color=color, radius=0.4, opacity=0.2)
        return VGroup(glow, vector)
    
    def create_player(self, position):
        body = Circle(radius=0.3, fill_color=BLUE_E, fill_opacity=1, stroke_color=BLUE_D, stroke_width=2)
        eye = Dot(position + UP*0.1 + RIGHT*0.1, color=WHITE, radius=0.08)
        pupil = Dot(position + UP*0.1 + RIGHT*0.12, color=BLACK, radius=0.04)
        direction = Triangle(color=BLUE_A, fill_opacity=0.8).scale(0.2).rotate(-PI/2).next_to(body, RIGHT, buff=0.05)
        player = VGroup(body, eye, pupil, direction).move_to(position)
        return player
    
    def create_enemy(self, position):
        body = RegularPolygon(n=6, radius=0.35, fill_color=RED_E, fill_opacity=1, stroke_color=RED_D, stroke_width=2)
        eye = Dot(position, color=YELLOW, radius=0.1)
        glow = self.create_glow(body, color=RED, radius=0.6, opacity=0.2)
        enemy = VGroup(glow, body, eye).move_to(position)
        return enemy
    
    def create_grid(self, width=16, height=9, spacing=1):
        grid = VGroup()
        for x in np.arange(-width/2, width/2 + spacing, spacing):
            line = Line(
                start=[x, -height/2, 0],
                end=[x, height/2, 0],
                stroke_color=BLUE_D,
                stroke_opacity=0.15,
                stroke_width=1
            )
            grid.add(line)
        for y in np.arange(-height/2, height/2 + spacing, spacing):
            line = Line(
                start=[-width/2, y, 0],
                end=[width/2, y, 0],
                stroke_color=BLUE_D,
                stroke_opacity=0.15,
                stroke_width=1
            )
            grid.add(line)
        return grid
    
    def create_coordinate_label(self, position, label_text, color=WHITE):
        label = MathTex(label_text, color=color, font_size=36)
        label.next_to(position, DR, buff=0.2)
        bg = SurroundingRectangle(label, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=0.7, stroke_width=0, buff=0.1)
        return VGroup(bg, label)
    
    def construct(self):
        # Color palette
        C_PRIMARY = "#00F0FF"
        C_SECONDARY = "#FF006E" 
        C_ACCENT = "#FFBE0B"
        C_BG = "#0F0F1A"
        C_GRID = "#1A1A2E"
        
        self.camera.background_color = C_BG
        
        # Title Sequence
        title = Text("Vectors in Video Games", font_size=72, color=C_PRIMARY, weight=BOLD)
        subtitle = Text("The Mathematics Behind Movement", font_size=36, color=WHITE)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        title_group = VGroup(title, subtitle).center()
        
        self.play(
            Write(title, run_time=1.5, rate_func=smooth),
            FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.5, run_time=1.5, rate_func=smooth)
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Transition to coordinate system
        grid = self.create_grid()
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-8, 8, 1],
            y_range=[-4.5, 4.5, 1],
            axis_config={"color": C_PRIMARY, "stroke_width": 2},
            tips=True
        )
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(title_group),
            FadeIn(grid, run_time=1),
            Create(axes, run_time=1.5),
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.8).move_to(ORIGIN),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Scene 1: Position Vectors
        scene_title = Text("Position Vectors", font_size=48, color=C_ACCENT).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.play(Write(scene_title))
        
        player = self.create_player(ORIGIN)
        self.play(FadeIn(player, scale=0.5))
        
        # Show position vector from origin
        pos_vector = self.create_neon_vector(ORIGIN, player.get_center(), color=C_PRIMARY)
        pos_label = self.create_coordinate_label(player.get_center(), "(3, 2)", C_PRIMARY)
        
        self.play(
            Create(pos_vector, run_time=1),
            FadeIn(pos_label)
        )
        
        # Move player to show vector updating
        new_pos = np.array([2, -1, 0])
        new_pos_vector = self.create_neon_vector(ORIGIN, new_pos, color=C_PRIMARY)
        new_label = self.create_coordinate_label(new_pos, "(2, -1)", C_PRIMARY)
        
        self.play(

            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(pos_vector), FadeOut(pos_label), FadeOut(scene_title))
        
        # Scene 2: Velocity Vectors

        # Show velocity vector

        vel_label = MathTex("\\vec{v} = (1.5, 1)", color=C_SECONDARY, font_size=36).next_to(vel_vector, UP, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(
            Create(vel_vector),
            Write(vel_label)
        )
        
        # Animate movement along velocity
        trail = TracedPath(player.get_center, stroke_color=C_SECONDARY, stroke_width=3, dissipating_time=0.5)
        self.add(trail)
        
        self.play(
            player.animate.shift(velocity_end*2),
            vel_vector.animate.shift(velocity_end*2),
            vel_label.animate.shift(velocity_end*2),
            run_time=3,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.remove(trail)
        
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(vel_vector), FadeOut(vel_label), FadeOut(vel_title))
        
        # Scene 3: Aiming/Shooting (Direction Vectors)
        aim_title = Text("Direction Vectors", font_size=48, color=C_ACCENT).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.play(Write(aim_title))
        
        # Add enemy

        enemy = self.create_enemy(enemy_pos)
        self.play(FadeIn(enemy, scale=0))

        direction = player_to_enemy / np.linalg.norm(player_to_enemy)
        aim_end = player.get_center() + direction * 2
        
        aim_vector = self.create_neon_vector(player.get_center(), aim_end, color=C_ACCENT, stroke_width=8)
        aim_label = MathTex("\\hat{d} = \\frac{\\vec{v}}{||\\vec{v}||}", color=C_ACCENT, font_size=36).next_to(aim_vector, UP)
        
        self.play(
            Create(aim_vector),
            Write(aim_label)
        )
        
        # Shoot projectile

        # Show WASD inputs as vectors
        w_vec = self.create_neon_vector(player.get_center(), player.get_center() + UP*1.5, color=BLUE, stroke_width=4)
        d_vec = self.create_neon_vector(player.get_center(), player.get_center() + RIGHT*2, color=GREEN, stroke_width=4)
        
        w_label = Text("W", color=BLUE, font_size=32).next_to(w_vec, LEFT, buff=0.2)
        d_label = Text("D", color=GREEN, font_size=32).next_to(d_vec, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(

            Write(w_label),
            Write(d_label)

        # Show resultant

            FadeOut(w_vec), FadeOut(d_vec), FadeOut(resultant),
            FadeOut(w_label), FadeOut(d_label), FadeOut(res_label),

        # Scene 5: Distance & Collision (Enemy AI)

        range_circle.move_to(enemy.get_center())

        self.play(

        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(1.3).move_to(ORIGIN),

        )

        tanh_lower = DashedLine(tanh_axes.c2p(-5, -1), tanh_axes.c2p(5, -1), color=C_TANH, stroke_opacity=0.4, dash_length=0.15)
        
        tanh_chars = VGroup(
            Text("• Output range: (-1, 1)", font_size=24, color="#2ecc71"),
            Text("• Zero-centered", font_size=24, color="#2ecc71"),
            Text("• Stronger gradients", font_size=24, color="#2ecc71"),
            Text("• Still vanishes at extremes", font_size=24, color="#e74c3c")
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3)
        tanh_chars.next_to(tanh_axes, RIGHT, buff=1.2)
        tanh_chars.align_to(tanh_axes, UP)
        
        tanh_container.add(tanh_title, tanh_formula, tanh_axes, tanh_upper, tanh_lower)
        
        # Pan camera to show comparison
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(RIGHT*3).set_width(18),
            run_time=2.5,
            rate_func=smooth
        )

            Write(tanh_title),
            Write(tanh_formula),
            run_time=1.5

        self.play(Create(tanh_upper), Create(tanh_lower))
        self.play(Create(tanh_graph), run_time=2.5, rate_func=smooth)
        
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(c, shift=RIGHT*0.2) for c in tanh_chars], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Transition to ReLU (clear screen)
        everything_old = VGroup(sigmoid_container, sig_graph, chars, tanh_container, tanh_graph, tanh_chars)
        
        relu_header = VGroup(
            Text("ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=56, color=C_RELU, weight=BOLD),
            Text("Rectified Linear Unit", font_size=32, color="#95a5a6")
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3)
        relu_header.to_edge(UP, buff=1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(everything_old),
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set_width(14),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # SECTION 3: RELU

        relu_axes.center()
        relu_axes.shift(DOWN*0.5)

        relu_graph = VMobject()
        relu_graph.set_points_as_corners(relu_points)
        relu_graph.set_stroke(color=C_RELU, width=6)
        
        # Glow effect

        # Dead zone highlight
        dead_rect = Rectangle(
            width=relu_axes.x_length/2,
            height=relu_axes.y_length/6,
            fill_color=C_RELU,
            fill_opacity=0.15,
            stroke_width=0
        )
        dead_rect.move_to(relu_axes.c2p(-2.5, 0))
        dead_label = Text("\"Dying ReLU\" - Gradient = 0", font_size=26, color=C_RELU).next_to(dead_rect, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(
            Write(relu_header),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.play(Write(relu_formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(relu_axes), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(relu_glow), Create(relu_graph), run_time=2.5, rate_func=smooth)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(dead_rect), Write(dead_label), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # SECTION 4: LEAKY RELU (Split screen)
        leaky_header = VGroup(
            Text("Leaky ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=48, color=C_LEAKY, weight=BOLD),
            MathTex(r"\alpha = 0.1", font_size=32, color=C_LEAKY)
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3)
        leaky_header.to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1.5).shift(UP*2)
        
        leaky_axes = styled_axes([-5, 5, 1], [-1, 5, 1], height=6, width=10)
        leaky_axes.move_to(relu_axes.get_center() + RIGHT*10)
        
        leaky_points = [leaky_axes.c2p(-5, -0.5), leaky_axes.c2p(0, 0), leaky_axes.c2p(5, 5)]

        leaky_glow = leaky_graph.copy().set_stroke(color=C_LEAKY, width=14, opacity=0.3)

        leaky_formula.next_to(leaky_header, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        # Transition to split view
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(RIGHT*4).set_width(20),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        self.play(
            Write(leaky_header),
            Write(leaky_formula),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(Create(leaky_axes), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(leaky_glow), Create(leaky_graph), run_time=2.5, rate_func=smooth)
        
        # Comparison arrow
        fix_arrow = CurvedArrow(
            relu_axes.c2p(-2, 1),
            leaky_axes.c2p(-2, 1),
            color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=3,
            angle=-0.3
        )
        fix_text = Text("Small negative slope\nfixes dead neurons", font_size=24, color=C_LEAKY, line_spacing=1.2)
        fix_text.next_to(fix_arrow, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Create(fix_arrow), Write(fix_text), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # FINAL COMPARISON GRID
        self.play(
            FadeOut(relu_header), FadeOut(relu_formula), FadeOut(relu_axes), 
            FadeOut(relu_graph), FadeOut(relu_glow), FadeOut(dead_rect), FadeOut(dead_label),
            FadeOut(leaky_header), FadeOut(leaky_formula), FadeOut(leaky_axes),
            FadeOut(leaky_graph), FadeOut(leaky_glow), FadeOut(fix_arrow), FadeOut(fix_text),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Create 2x2 grid of mini graphs
        mini_config = {"height": 3, "width": 4.5}
        
        # Sigmoid mini
        s_ax = styled_axes([-3, 3, 1], [0, 1, 0.5], **mini_config)
        s_graph = s_ax.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x)), color=C_SIGMOID, stroke_width=4)
        s_label = Text("Sigmoid", font_size=28, color=C_SIGMOID, weight=BOLD).next_to(s_ax, UP, buff=0.2)
        s_group = VGroup(s_ax, s_graph, s_label)
        
        # Tanh mini
        t_ax = styled_axes([-3, 3, 1], [-1, 1, 0.5], **mini_config)
        t_graph = t_ax.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x), color=C_TANH, stroke_width=4)
        t_label = Text("Tanh", font_size=28, color=C_TANH, weight=BOLD).next_to(t_ax, UP, buff=0.2)
        t_group = VGroup(t_ax, t_graph, t_label)
        
        # ReLU mini
        r_ax = styled_axes([-3, 3, 1], [-0.5, 3, 1], **mini_config)
        r_graph = VMobject()
        r_graph.set_points_as_corners([r_ax.c2p(-3, 0), r_ax.c2p(0, 0), r_ax.c2p(3, 3)])
        r_graph.set_stroke(color=C_RELU, width=4)
        r_label = Text("ReLU", font_size=28, color=C_RELU, weight=BOLD).next_to(r_ax, UP, buff=0.2)
        r_group = VGroup(r_ax, r_graph, r_label)
        
        # Leaky mini
        l_ax = styled_axes([-3, 3, 1], [-0.5, 3, 1], **mini_config)
        l_graph = VMobject()
        l_graph.set_points_as_corners([l_ax.c2p(-3, -0.3), l_ax.c2p(0, 0), l_ax.c2p(3, 3)])
        l_graph.set_stroke(color=C_LEAKY, width=4)
        l_label = Text("Leaky ReLU", font_size=28, color=C_LEAKY, weight=BOLD).next_to(l_ax, UP, buff=0.2)
        l_group = VGroup(l_ax, l_graph, l_label)
        
        # Position grid
        top_row = VGroup(s_group, t_group).arrange(RIGHT, buff=2)
        bot_row = VGroup(r_group, l_group).arrange(RIGHT, buff=2)
        grid = VGroup(top_row, bot_row).arrange(DOWN, buff=1.5)
        grid.center()
        
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set_width(16),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                Create(s_group),
                Create(t_group),
                Create(r_group),
                Create(l_group),
                lag_ratio=0.2
            ),
            run_time=3
        )
        
        # Key insight
        insight = Text(
            "The choice of activation shapes how your network learns.",
            font_size=36,
            color=C_TEXT,
            weight=BOLD
        )
        insight.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1)
        
        self.play(Write(insight), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Outro
        self.play(
            FadeOut(grid),
            FadeOut(insight),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        final = Text("Modern defaults: ReLU for hidden layers, Sigmoid/Softmax for output", 
                    font_size=38, color=C_TEXT, line_spacing=1.5)
        final.center()
        
        highlight = SurroundingRectangle(final, color=C_ACCENT, stroke_width=3, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(Write(final), run_time=2.5)
        self.play(Create(highlight), run_time=1)
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(final), FadeOut(highlight), FadeOut(title_group), run_time=2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class GVERichScene(MovingCameraScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Cinematic configuration
        self.camera.background_color = "#0f0f0f"
        
        # --- SCENE 1: Title ---
        title = Text("ACTIVATION FUNCTIONS", font_size=64, weight=BOLD, color=WHITE)
        title.set_stroke(width=1, opacity=0.8)
        
        subtitle = Text("Bringing Non-Linearity to Neural Networks", 
                       font_size=32, color=BLUE_D, slant=ITALIC)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        title_glow = title.copy().set_color(BLUE_D).set_opacity(0.3).scale(1.1)
        title_glow.set_z_index(title.z_index - 1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(title_glow, scale=1.2),
            Write(title, rate_func=smooth),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.3), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(1.2),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        self.play(FadeOut(title_glow), FadeOut(title), FadeOut(subtitle))
        
        # --- SCENE 2: The Problem ---
        problem_title = Text("The Linear Limitation", font_size=40, color=GRAY_A)
        problem_title.to_edge(UP, buff=1)
        
        eq1 = MathTex(r"h_1 = W_1x + b_1", font_size=36)
        eq2 = MathTex(r"h_2 = W_2h_1 + b_2", font_size=36)
        eq3 = MathTex(r"\Rightarrow h_2 = W_{effective}x + b_{effective}", font_size=36, color=RED_D)
        
        eq1.shift(UP)
        eq2.next_to(eq1, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        eq3.next_to(eq2, DOWN, buff=1.2)
        
        self.play(Write(problem_title))
        self.play(Write(eq1), run_time=1)
        self.play(Write(eq2), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Write(eq3), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(problem_title),
            FadeOut(eq1),
            FadeOut(eq2),
            FadeOut(eq3),
            run_time=0.8
        )
        
        # --- SCENE 3: ReLU Equation ---
        relu_equation = MathTex(r"f(x) = \max(0, x)", font_size=72, color=BLUE_E)
        relu_equation.set_stroke(width=2, opacity=0.8)
        
        bg_rect = SurroundingRectangle(relu_equation, buff=0.5, 
                                      fill_color=BLUE_D, fill_opacity=0.1,
                                      stroke_color=BLUE_D, stroke_width=2)
        
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.8),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        self.play(
            Create(bg_rect),
            Write(relu_equation),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)
        
        # --- SCENE 4: Graph Visualization ---
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-4, 4, 1],
            y_range=[-1, 4, 1],
            x_length=10,
            y_length=6,
            axis_config={
                "color": GRAY_B,
                "stroke_width": 2,
                "tip_height": 0.2,
                "tip_width": 0.2,
            },
            x_axis_config={"numbers_to_include": [-3, 0, 3]},
            y_axis_config={"numbers_to_include": [0, 3]},
        )
        
        axes.to_edge(RIGHT, buff=1.5)
        axes.shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        
        x_label = MathTex(r"x", font_size=32, color=GRAY_C).next_to(axes.x_axis, RIGHT)
        y_label = MathTex(r"f(x)", font_size=32, color=GRAY_C).next_to(axes.y_axis, UP)
        
        neg_part = Line(
            axes.c2p(-4, 0),
            axes.c2p(0, 0),
            stroke_width=8,
            color=RED_B,
            stroke_opacity=0.8
        )
        
        pos_part = Line(
            axes.c2p(0, 0),
            axes.c2p(4, 4),
            stroke_width=8,
            color=BLUE_B,
            stroke_opacity=0.9
        )
        
        hinge = Dot(axes.c2p(0, 0), radius=0.15, color=YELLOW_D)
        hinge.set_stroke(WHITE, width=2)
        
        dead_text = Text("Inactive\n(0)", font_size=24, color=RED_C, weight=BOLD)
        dead_text.move_to(axes.c2p(-2, 0.5))
        
        active_text = Text("Active\n(x)", font_size=24, color=BLUE_C, weight=BOLD)
        active_text.move_to(axes.c2p(2, 2.5))
        
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(1.6).move_to(np.array([2, -0.5, 0])),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        equation_panel = relu_equation.copy()
        equation_panel.scale(0.7).to_edge(LEFT, buff=1.5)
        equation_panel.shift(UP * 1.5)
        
        eq_box = SurroundingRectangle(equation_panel, buff=0.3, 
                                     fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=0.8,
                                     stroke_color=BLUE_D, stroke_width=2)
        
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(relu_equation, equation_panel),
            FadeOut(relu_equation),
            FadeOut(bg_rect),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(Create(eq_box))
        
        self.play(Create(axes), Write(x_label), Write(y_label), run_time=1.5)
        
        self.play(
            Create(neg_part),
            FadeIn(dead_text),
            run_time=1.2
        )
        self.play(
            Create(pos_part),
            FadeIn(active_text),
            run_time=1.2
        )
        self.play(FadeIn(hinge, scale=2))
        
        self.play(hinge.animate.scale(1.3), run_time=0.3)
        self.play(hinge.animate.scale(1/1.3), run_time=0.3)
        
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # --- SCENE 5: Properties ---
        props = VGroup()
        p1 = Text("Simple & Fast", font_size=28, color=WHITE)
        p2 = Text("Non-linear", font_size=28, color=WHITE)
        p3 = Text("Sparse Activations", font_size=28, color=WHITE)
        
        props.add(p1, p2, p3)
        props.arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.6)
        props.to_edge(LEFT, buff=1.5)
        props.shift(DOWN * 1.5)
        
        check_marks = VGroup()
        for p in props:
            check = MathTex(r"\checkmark", font_size=32, color=GREEN_D)
            check.next_to(p, LEFT, buff=0.4)
            check_marks.add(check)
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[Write(p) for p in props], lag_ratio=0.3),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(cm, scale=2) for cm in check_marks], lag_ratio=0.3),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # --- SCENE 6: Finale ---
        self.wait(1)
        
        all_elements = VGroup(
            equation_panel, eq_box, axes, x_label, y_label,
            neg_part, pos_part, hinge, dead_text, active_text,
            props, check_marks
        )
        
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.9).move_to(all_elements.get_center()),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        self.play(
            equation_panel.animate.set_color(YELLOW_D).scale(1.1),
            run_time=0.5
        )
        self.play(
            equation_panel.animate.set_color(BLUE_E).scale(1/1.1),
            run_time=0.5
        )
        
        self.wait(2)
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(all_elements),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        final = Text("Rectified Linear Unit", font_size=48, color=BLUE_D, weight=BOLD)
        final_sub = Text("The Modern Default", font_size=32, color=GRAY_C)
        final_sub.next_to(final, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        self.play(
            Write(final),
            FadeIn(final_sub, shift=UP*0.5),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(2)

            t_min=-10,

            color=YELLOW,

            t_max=10,

        self.play(Write(tanh_text))
        self.play(ShowCreation(tanh_graph))

        self.wait(2)

        softplus_text = Tex(r"f(x) = \ln(1+e^x)")
        softplus_graph = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: (t, np.log(1 + np.exp(t))),
            t_min=-10,
            t_max=10,
            color=RED,
        )
        softplus_graph_label = Tex(r"\text{Softplus}").scale(0.7).next_to(softplus_graph, DOWN)

        self.play(FadeOut(tanh_text, tanh_graph, tanh_graph_label))
        self.play(Write(softplus_text))
        self.play(ShowCreation(softplus_graph))
        self.play(Write(softplus_graph_label))
        self.wait(2)

        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.5).move_to(ORIGIN),
            run_time=2,
        )
        self.wait(1)

        self.play(Transform(intro_text, sigmoid_text), Create(sigmoid_graph), Create(sigmoid_function))

        # Tanh Function
        tanh_text = Text("Tanh Function", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
        tanh_graph = Axes(x_range=[-10, 10, 2], y_range=[-1.1, 1.1, 0.1], axis_config={"include_tip": False})

        # ReLU Function

        relu_graph = Axes(x_range=[-10, 10, 2], y_range=[-1, 10, 1], axis_config={"include_tip": False})

        # Leaky ReLU Function
        leaky_relu_text = Text("Leaky ReLU Function", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)

        # Conclusion
